import pandas as pd

# Read source table with index_col=0 as per hint 21
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_65/training_0.csv", index_col=0)

# Filter out invalid years (year == 0 or NaN)
source0 = source0[source0['year'].notna() & (source0['year'] != 0)]

# Group by 'year' and count the number of rows per year
result = source0.groupby('year', as_index=False).agg({'year':'count'})

# Rename the count column to '0' as per target schema
result = result.rename(columns={'year':'0'})

# Ensure 'year' column is integer type (matches target schema)
result['year'] = result['year'].astype(int) if 'year' in result.columns else result['year']
result['0'] = result['0'].astype(int)

# Write output to the required path
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_65/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
